item.name: Tip Jar
item.effectSummary: Adds a way to earn extra cash from customers.
item.cardSummary: Tip Jar is an early cash upgrade. Buy it when small customer payments are still deciding your next purchase.

item.name: Waiter Tray
item.effectSummary: Lets a waiter carry 3 dishes after the worker meets the tray requirement.
item.cardSummary: Waiter Tray improves serving flow by raising dish-carrying capacity, but the source trivia notes waiters need level 3 to use it.

item.name: Drinks
item.effectSummary: Adds drinks to the restaurant menu.
item.cardSummary: Drinks is a low-cost menu expansion. It is useful when you want more restaurant offerings before larger build or kitchen purchases.

item.name: Level 2 Kitchens
item.effectSummary: Unlocks industrial kitchen pieces that cook faster and improve food rating.
item.cardSummary: Level 2 Kitchens is the first kitchen tier upgrade. It helps when food speed and quality start mattering more than basic menu unlocks.

item.name: Basic Advertising
item.effectSummary: Starts the advertising chain with poster advertising that raises customer spawn rate.
item.cardSummary: Basic Advertising is the first customer-flow upgrade and also unlocks Manager Desk, making it a key early branch.

item.name: Kids Menu
item.effectSummary: Adds a separate menu for kids.
item.cardSummary: Kids Menu is a menu expansion and the prerequisite for Restaurant Storage, so it can matter before storage-focused purchases.

item.name: Manager Desk
item.effectSummary: Unlocks management options tied to restaurant stats and later operations.
item.cardSummary: Manager Desk opens the management branch for controls, franchise, security, and related restaurant tools.

item.name: Restaurant Storage
item.effectSummary: Unlocks kitchen storage for toys, plates, bowls, and other restaurant supplies.
item.cardSummary: Restaurant Storage expands what the restaurant can hold and use after Kids Menu is purchased.

item.name: Waiter Cart
item.effectSummary: Raises carrying capacity to 4 dishes after the worker meets the cart requirement.
item.cardSummary: Waiter Cart is the next service-capacity step after Waiter Tray, with source trivia noting waiters need level 5 to use it.

item.name: Restaurant Controls
item.effectSummary: Adds VIP-only tables and staff-only doors, stairs, and elevators.
item.cardSummary: Restaurant Controls is a management upgrade for controlling who can use specific tables and staff routes.

item.name: Franchise
item.effectSummary: Starts the franchise feature through the Manager Desk for offline earnings.
item.cardSummary: Franchise turns restaurant progress into an offline-income system once Manager Desk is available.

item.name: Left Expansion
item.effectSummary: Expands the restaurant plot to the left.
item.cardSummary: Left Expansion is an early space upgrade for players who need more build room on the left side of the restaurant.

item.name: Right Expansion
item.effectSummary: Expands the restaurant plot to the right.
item.cardSummary: Right Expansion gives more build space and also leads into the Drive Thru requirement.

item.name: Security
item.effectSummary: Unlocks security cameras and helps reduce dine-and-dash customers.
item.cardSummary: Security is a Manager Desk branch upgrade for monitoring the restaurant and cutting down dine-and-dash losses.

item.name: Level 3 Kitchens
item.effectSummary: Unlocks marble kitchens that cook faster and improve food rating.
item.cardSummary: Level 3 Kitchens is the mid-tier kitchen upgrade after Level 2 Kitchens, aimed at faster cooking and better food rating.

item.name: Print Advertising
item.effectSummary: Adds newspaper advertising to further raise customer spawn rate.
item.cardSummary: Print Advertising continues the customer-flow chain after Basic Advertising and leads toward larger advertising upgrades.

item.name: Card Payments
item.effectSummary: Gives customers a 50% chance to pay by card.
item.cardSummary: Card Payments is a payment-flow upgrade tied to Tip Jar. It helps money collection without turning every customer payment automatic.

item.name: Back Expansion
item.effectSummary: Expands the restaurant plot toward the back.
item.cardSummary: Back Expansion opens the rear build-space chain and becomes the prerequisite for second-stage side and back expansions.

item.name: Drive Thru
item.effectSummary: Unlocks a drive-thru lane that can be built alongside the restaurant.
item.cardSummary: Drive Thru adds a new service lane after Right Expansion, making it both a build unlock and an operations upgrade.

item.name: Level 4 Kitchens
item.effectSummary: Unlocks advanced cooking stations and increases cooking speed.
item.cardSummary: Level 4 Kitchens is the advanced kitchen tier, adding stations such as grills, pizza ovens, tandoors, and digital order counters.

item.name: Billboard Advertising
item.effectSummary: Adds billboard promotion to improve customer spawn rate.
item.cardSummary: Billboard Advertising is the third advertising step and sets up Media Advertising later.

item.name: Right Expansion 2
item.effectSummary: Adds another right-side space upgrade after Back Expansion.
item.cardSummary: Right Expansion 2 is a second-stage plot upgrade for restaurants that need more room after the first expansions.

item.name: Left Expansion 2
item.effectSummary: Adds another left-side space upgrade after Back Expansion.
item.cardSummary: Left Expansion 2 continues the build-space route once Back Expansion is unlocked.

item.name: Back Expansion 2
item.effectSummary: Adds a second rear plot expansion.
item.cardSummary: Back Expansion 2 is the key second-stage space upgrade because it unlocks third-stage side expansions and extra floors.

item.name: Media Advertising
item.effectSummary: Promotes the restaurant on TV to increase customer spawn rate.
item.cardSummary: Media Advertising is the top listed advertising upgrade and follows the full Basic to Print to Billboard chain.

item.name: Left Expansion 3
item.effectSummary: Adds another left-side space upgrade after Back Expansion 2.
item.cardSummary: Left Expansion 3 is a late plot-size purchase for larger restaurant layouts after the second back expansion.

item.name: Right Expansion 3
item.effectSummary: Adds another right-side space upgrade after Back Expansion 2.
item.cardSummary: Right Expansion 3 is a late right-side space purchase for wider restaurant builds.

item.name: Second Floor
item.effectSummary: Adds another floor to the restaurant.
item.cardSummary: Second Floor is a major space upgrade that opens vertical building after Back Expansion 2.

item.name: Third Floor
item.effectSummary: Adds a third restaurant floor.
item.cardSummary: Third Floor is the highest listed floor upgrade and follows Second Floor as a late space goal.
